webpage.headline: Turn a PDF into code you control
webpage.subhead: A standalone HTML page or a drop-in React component — converted in your browser, so the file is never uploaded anywhere.
webpage.figureBeforeNote: the words are part of the picture
webpage.sample1: Revenue rose 12% against the same period last year.
webpage.sample2: Select this line — in the PDF you could not.
webpage.sample3: Headcount held steady across all three sites.
webpage.howLead: Every page is built from two layers. That is what lets the result look identical to the original and still be text.
webpage.layerRasterBody: Carries every vector drawing, image and rule from the original, exactly as they were.
webpage.layerTextBody: Real positioned text on top of it — selectable, searchable, translatable, editable.
webpage.layerResultBody: Looks like the original, but you can highlight the words, search them and change them.
webpage.case1Title: You have a document that should be a page
webpage.case1Body: A report, a catalogue, a menu. Instead of a file people download and open in a reader, a page that loads, scrolls on a phone and can be linked to.
webpage.case2Title: You are building something and need a document inside it
webpage.case2Body: Terms, a spec sheet, a lesson. A React component you style and control, instead of an iframe with a PDF viewer in it.
webpage.case3Body: The designer moved on and the source file went with them. The PDF is all that is left, and the text and layout come back as something you can edit.
webpage.case4Title: The content is locked and you need to change it
webpage.case4Body: Translating, correcting, restyling. The text stays text — and Hebrew comes out the right way round, which copying from a PDF famously does not.
webpage.outputsLead: Two today. Tell us which one to build next — the counter is what decides.
webpage.noted: Noted — thank you. Signed-in accounts get told when it lands.
webpage.notedSignIn: Noted. Sign in and we can tell you when it lands.
webpage.interestFailed: That did not get recorded. Try again in a moment.
webpage.outHtmlBody: One standalone page that opens in any browser.
webpage.outReactBody: A component ready to drop into a project.
webpage.outVueBody: The same component, for a Vue project.
webpage.outSvelteBody: The same component, for a Svelte project.
webpage.outPythonBody: Not a page but a script — one that redraws the document with different data.
webpage.privacyTitle: The file never leaves your browser
webpage.privacyBody: The conversion runs on your machine. We do not upload the document, store it, or see it.
webpage.rtlBody: Language and direction are read from the document itself, so a Hebrew PDF comes out as a declared right-to-left page rather than an English one facing the wrong way.
webpage.outputBody: One standalone page, or a component ready to drop into a project. Everything downloads as a ZIP.
webpage.limitsTitle: And what it does not do
webpage.limit1: Pages keep their original size — they do not reflow to a narrow screen.
webpage.limit2: A scan with no text layer stays an image. There is no OCR.
webpage.limit3: PowerPoint files are not supported yet.
webpage.closingBody: It takes about as long as opening the file.
webpage.videoLead: A minute and a half, narrated in Hebrew. A real document, the code it becomes, and what you can do with it.
webpage.videoFallback: This browser cannot play the video.
webpage.aboutLead: What it does, what it cannot do yet, and what is coming — in full.
webpage.fitPrivacy: Runs in your browser. The file is never uploaded.
webpage.fitRtl: Hebrew and Arabic export with the right language and direction.
webpage.fitFidelity: The page looks identical; the text stays real text.

login.accountSubtitle: Sign in to your account, or create one.
login.accountsUnavailable: Accounts are not configured on this deployment. Set the Firebase variables in .env.local.
login.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
login.errorBadCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
login.errorBadEmail: That is not a valid email address.
login.errorEmailTaken: An account already exists for that email. Sign in instead.
login.errorWeakPassword: That password is too weak. Use a longer one.
login.errorTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorNetwork: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.
login.errorProviderOff: That sign-in method is not enabled for this project.
login.errorUnauthorizedDomain: This domain is not registered with Firebase, so Google sign-in is blocked here. Email and password still work.
login.devSignInNote: Local development only — this button does not exist in a production build.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyBody: Activity is kept in this browser tab only and disappears when you refresh. Your files never leave your computer.

convert.title: Convert
convert.pdfIntro: Converted in your browser. The file is never uploaded anywhere.
convert.deckIntro: Google exports your deck straight to this tab — it does not pass through our server.
convert.deckIntroWithPptx: A Google Slides deck is exported straight to this tab. A PowerPoint file is sent to our server to be converted, and deleted in the same request.
convert.chooseFile: Choose a PDF or PowerPoint file
convert.dragHint: or drag one anywhere on this page
convert.keepGraphicsOn: Vector art and images are preserved as a background layer. Larger file, looks identical to the PDF.
convert.keepGraphicsOff: Text only — clean, editable markup, but any graphics from the original are dropped.
convert.pptxUnavailable: PowerPoint conversion is not available here. Export “{name}” as a PDF and convert that.
convert.belongsOnPdf: “{name}” is a PDF. Convert it on the PDF screen.
convert.belongsOnDecks: “{name}” is a presentation. Convert it on the Presentations screen.
convert.slidesOnlyBody: PowerPoint files need a server that can run LibreOffice, which this deployment does not have. Import the deck from Google Slides, or export it as a PDF and convert that.
convert.deckUnavailableBody: This deployment has neither Google Slides configured nor a server that can convert PowerPoint. Export your deck as a PDF and convert it on the PDF screen.
convert.converted: Converted {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
convert.scannedBody: It has no text layer, so the output will keep the page images but the text will not be selectable or searchable.
convert.tooLongBody: Only the first {limit} will be converted.
convert.quotaSpentTitle: This month's conversions are used up.
convert.quotaSpent: The free plan covers {limit} documents a month, and the count starts over at the beginning of next month. Running a project you have already converted still works.
convert.rerunSlides: Fetching it from Google Drive. You may be asked to allow access again — the permission is short-lived by design.
convert.rerunPick: The file itself was never stored, so choose it again to continue. Your settings from last time are already selected.
convert.rerunMismatchTitle: This is not quite the file from last time.
convert.rerunMismatch: The name or size is different. That is fine if you meant to convert an updated version — carry on.
convert.uploadedTitle: This presentation was converted on our server.
convert.uploadedBody: PowerPoint has no browser converter, so the file was sent to us, turned into a PDF and deleted immediately — nothing was stored. Everything from here on happens in your browser, as it does for a PDF.

preview.outputHint: The converted page on its own
preview.truncated: Showing the first {shown}k characters of {total}k — this file is large enough that laying all of it out takes a moment.
preview.renderFailed: Could not render the original page.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Kept with your account. Your documents are not.
activity.runAgainHint: Fetch it from Drive and convert it again
activity.repickHint: The file was never stored — you will be asked to choose it again
activity.clearConfirm: Delete every record? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The interface language. Your documents are converted in whatever language they are written in.
settings.defaultsHint: Pre-selected the next time you convert something.
settings.allowanceHint: Counted per document. Running a saved project again is free, and the count starts over at the beginning of each month.
settings.allowanceSpent: You have used this month's conversions. Running a project you have already converted still works, and the count starts over at the beginning of next month.
settings.keepFileNamesOn: Your history shows each document by name. A name can say as much as the document — turn this off and they are stored as “Document” instead.
settings.keepFileNamesOff: New conversions are stored without a name. Your documents were never stored either way.
settings.namesForgotten: {count, plural, one {# stored name was forgotten.} other {# stored names were forgotten.}}
settings.storageHint: Your documents are never uploaded or stored — a PDF is converted entirely in this browser. We keep your account: your email and name, and a count of what you have converted. History lives in this tab only and is gone when you refresh.

warnings.SCANNED: This PDF has no text layer — it is a scan. The output keeps the page images, but the text will not be selectable or searchable without OCR.
warnings.GRAPHICS_DROPPED: {count, plural, one {# page contains} other {# pages contain}} graphics that text-only output cannot reproduce. Turn on “Keep graphics” to keep them.
warnings.TRUNCATED: Only the first {limit} of {total} pages were converted.
warnings.NO_OFFSCREEN_CANVAS: This browser cannot render page backgrounds, so the output is text-only. Try Chrome, Edge or a recent Firefox for full visual fidelity.

desktop.projectsEmpty: What you convert shows up here, and survives a restart
desktop.local: Everything is local. No file leaves this machine.
desktop.engineNotInApp: Running in a browser rather than the app, so there is no engine to talk to.
desktop.convertScanned: This document has no text layer — it is a scan. The images are kept, but the text will not be searchable without OCR.
desktop.convertGraphics: {count} pages contain graphics that text-only output cannot reproduce.
desktop.previewSandboxed: Shown in a sandbox: no scripts, no access to the app.
desktop.convertUnmapped: {count} characters could not be read from the document fonts and were left out. The rest of the text is unaffected.
desktop.projectsMissing: The source file is no longer where it was
desktop.projectsChanged: The source file has changed since it was converted
desktop.sourcesRefused: {count} files were not added — only PDF is supported.
desktop.sourcesFirstRun: Drop PDF files here, or add them. Conversion runs on this machine only.
desktop.engineDownHelp: The engine did not start, so nothing can be converted. Restarting it usually fixes this, and the window stays open.
desktop.workbenchOverwriteAsk: The file you chose is one of the plan's sources. Saving over it replaces the original document, and that cannot be undone.
desktop.workbenchEmptyHint: Open a PDF to see its pages. Rotate, reorder, delete, extract and merge are all edits to the same list, and nothing is written to disk until you choose where.
desktop.workbenchDropEnd: Drop here to move to the end
desktop.engineErrorUnreadable: The document could not be opened. It may be damaged, empty, or not a PDF.
desktop.engineErrorEncrypted: The document is encrypted and cannot be opened.
desktop.engineErrorUnwritable: The output could not be written. Check the folder and the free space.
desktop.engineErrorSourceOverwrite: That file is one of the documents open in the page editor. Source files are never written over; choose another name.
desktop.engineErrorNotSmaller: No file was created: compressing would not have saved space. Yours is {before} KB, and the rewritten copy would have been {after} KB.
desktop.engineErrorHung: The engine stopped responding and was restarted. Try again.
desktop.engineErrorRefused: The engine refused the request. The details are in the log.
desktop.engineErrorInternal: Something went wrong in the engine. Nothing was written; the details are in the log.
desktop.viewerRenderFailed: This page could not be drawn.
desktop.settingsShortcutEdges: Move the selected pages to the start / end
desktop.settingsShortcutMenu: Open the right-click menu from the keyboard
desktop.workbenchUntouched: Source files are never changed. Saving writes a new document where you choose.
desktop.deliverCopyFailed: The clipboard was blocked in this window.
desktop.deliverReveal: Show the file in its folder
desktop.previewSource: {file} — source. A component is not a page, so it is shown rather than run.
desktop.settingsAppearanceNote: Language and theme are kept in this window. Documents are converted in the language they are written in, not the interface language.
desktop.settingsDefaultsNote: Pre-selected for the next conversion, and after the app is closed and opened again.
desktop.settingsHistoryNote: Only the list is cleared. Output files on disk stay where they are — deleting somebody's files because they tidied a list is a surprise, and an irreversible one.
desktop.settingsCreditsNote: Third-party components, at the versions actually installed.
desktop.introWhat: Drop in a PDF, choose HTML or React, and the document comes out as editable code — with real text you can select and search, not a picture of words.
desktop.introWhere: Output is saved in the app's data folder, and you can change that in Settings. When a conversion finishes there is a button that opens the folder.
desktop.introLocal: Conversion runs on this machine only. No file is sent anywhere.
desktop.settingsStorageSummary: {size} in the app's output folder, across {count} conversion folders.
desktop.settingsStorageNote: Only folders not named in the history are removed. A folder you chose as an output destination — one picked in a dialog rather than the app's own default — is never touched from here.
desktop.settingsStorageNothingToClean: Nothing to clean — every folder is either recent or still named in the history.
desktop.settingsStorageUnavailable: Could not read the app's output folder.
desktop.settingsShortcutsNote: No shortcut fires while typing in a text field — each one checks where focus is before it does anything.
desktop.itemHung: The engine stopped answering and could not continue. It has been restarted — you can try again.
desktop.itemUnreadable: The document could not be opened. {detail}
desktop.settingsReportNote: If something breaks, this helps us work out what. It contains the engine log only — no file names, no paths, no document contents. You can read all of it before handing it over.
desktop.itemUnwritable: The output could not be written. {detail}
desktop.workbenchScannedExplained: This document is scanned — it is pictures of pages with no text layer. Rotate, reorder, delete, merge, save and export all work as usual; finding and copying text do not, because there is nothing to find. Character recognition (OCR) is not in this version.
desktop.viewerEmpty: No page to show. Open a document, or click a page in the strip.
